title: Learning a Group Element from Its Action: Galois Correspondences, Optimal ERM, and an Abel-Ruffini Threshold for the Natarajan Dimension
abstract: arXiv:2610.18154v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study learning an unknown element $g$ of a group acting with finite orbits on a countable set, from examples $(x,gx)$. After a sample on $A$, the consistent hypotheses are the restrictions of a coset of the pointwise stabilizer of $A$, and the sample forces exactly the labels of points this stabilizer fixes; for a Galois group, they form the field generated by the data. Through this correspondence, multiclass dimensions become group invariants: the DS and graph dimensions equal the height, the Littlestone dimension the longest irredundant sequence length, and the teaching dimension the minimal base size. Among deterministic learners, symmetry makes empirical risk minimization optimal: on nondegenerate classes every consistent learner, whatever its tie-breaking, attains the optimal realizable sample complexity up to constant factors, and every consistent online learner the optimal mistake bound. translated_title: 从群元素的作用中学习群元素：伽罗瓦对应、最优经验风险最小化（ERM）与Natarajan维数的阿贝尔-鲁菲尼阈值
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何从样本 $(x, gx)$ 中学习一个在可数集合上以有限轨道作用的群中的未知元素 $g$。在集合 $A$ 上采样后，一致的假设是 $A$ 的逐点稳定子的某个陪集的限制，且样本恰好强制确定了该稳定子所固定点的标签；对于伽罗瓦群，这些一致的假设构成由数据生成的域。通过这一对应关系，多类学习的维度成为群的不变量：DS 维度和图维度等于轨道高度（height），Littlestone 维度等于最长无冗余序列的长度，教学维度等于最小基的大小。在确定性学习者中，对称性使经验风险最小化成为最优方法：在非退化类上，任何一致的学习者，无论其如何打破平局，都在常数因子内达到最优的可实现样本复杂度，且任何一致的在线学习者都达到最优的错误上界。在不可知（agnostic）情形下，每个 ERM 的样本复杂度……
tldr: 该论文建立了从样本学习群元素与伽罗瓦理论之间的对应关系，将多类学习的 DS 维度、Littlestone 维度和教学维度化为群不变量，并证明在对称类上任何一致的 ERM 学习者均达到最优样本复杂度，同时揭示了 Natarajan 维数存在阿贝尔-鲁菲尼式的阈值。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a Galois correspondence for learning a group element from its action, showing that multiclass dimensions (DS, Littlestone, and teaching dimensions) become group invariants, that symmetry makes every consistent ERM learner optimal, and revealing an Abel-Ruffini-type threshold for the Natarajan dimension.
